description: This circular walk explores the countryside around the Herefordshire villages of Hoarwithy and King's Caple. You can start your walk from the New Harp Inn where you can enjoy fine food and drink before and after your walk. The walk includes a visit to nearby King's Caple and some fine views of the River Wye and the surrounding Herefordshire hills and countryside. The route is fairly easy with some small climbs along the way. To continue your walking in the area head east to pick up the Brampton Abbotts and Hole In The Wall Circular Walk and the Ross Round Circular Walk .
